integrity: All finite verification results are supplements to the analytic argument; no independent validation or authorship assertion.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to an edge-seeded, one-edge-per-arrival attachment tree with probability proportional to undirected degree; shows covariance/correlation only, not full joint distribution or stochastic ordering. Historical priority remains subject to unseen equivalent literature.
title: Root–leaf covariance in degree-proportional attachment trees
